items.title: OSNI Benchmarks (Height Reference Points) source files
items.subtitle: OSNI Reference Layers / OSNI
items.description: Historic OSNI benchmarks — small brass plates or chiselled grooves set into permanent features (bridges, walls, milestones) whose heights above Ordnance Datum were precisely determined by levelling surveys.
